title: Backyard Worlds: *USA* leads
hook: 96 hours in, four nations are left and 100 yards is in sight.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: As of 21 Oct, 15:36 CEST, the USA leads the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship on 1,099 yards. Australia finished on 1,069 with no runners left.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: USA, Japan, Belgium and France each have 2 runners left. Japan is on 1,021 yards, Belgium 1,002, France 880.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: The USA heads back to the trail for yard 97. Every yard is a 6.7 km loop run hourly, and a nation's race ends when one runner completes a yard alone. Totals are provisional.

sources: Official live standings, Big's Backyard Ultra (21 Oct 2026, 15:36 CEST)
caption:
NEWS: Backyard Worlds: Australia is out, USA leads

As of 21 Oct, 15:36 CEST, the USA leads the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship on 1,099 yards. Australia finished on 1,069. USA, Japan, Belgium and France each have 2 runners left, and 100 yards is in sight. Totals are provisional.
